title: Krishna Gaadi Veera Prema Gaadha
desc: Krishna falls in love with Mahalakshmi whose brother is a henchman of a don. During a gang war, he entrusts the responsibility of children to Krishna and asks him to return them to their parents.

title: To Let
desc: A family of three faces hardship as they desperately search for a new rental home after their landlady demands they leave their current house.

title: Pisasu
desc: Upon witnessing the death of a young girl in an accident, Siddharth, a violinist, begins to feel a supernatural presence in his house. The mystery begins to unfold when he meets the girl's father.

title: Bhoomi
desc: Bhoominathan, a NASA scientist, helps his village people against the evil corporations.

title: Minnal Murali
desc: Jaison, a young tailor, gains superpowers after being struck by lightning. However, he must thwart the evil intentions of an unexpected adversary to become the superhero that his rural village needs.

title: Action
desc: Subhash, an army man, seeks vengeance when a conspiracy claims his loved ones. He investigates the plot and takes matters into his own hands, mounting a daring operation to capture the culprit.

title: Lucifer
desc: The demise of the leader of a political party leads to a massive power struggle. Amidst the chaos, a mystical man named Stephen comes in to ascend the throne.
